about_the_game:
Introducing the Micro Drone Edition DLC, the ultimate package designed to enhance your micro FPV drone flying experience! Whether you’re a seasoned pilot or just starting out, this DLC brings the most comprehensive collection of micro drone content to elevate your skills and enjoyment.

This structure ensures continuous expansion with new drones, maps, tracks, and features, keeping the FPV experience fresh and ever-evolving.

This package includes:

Japan Pack

The Japan Pack, created in collaboration with WTW (Wednesday Tokyo Whoopers), brings the vibrant world of Japanese micro FPV drone racing to life. Featuring four dynamic racetracks and a beautifully designed Garden map.

Wider selection of micro drones

To further enhance your experience, alongside the ORQA Whoop, the baseline micro drone available in the simulator, we’re introducing two new micro drones:

  • Bolt – A high-speed racing micro drone designed for competitive flying.

  • Cloud – Built for agile movement and easy handling, perfect for smooth freestyle flights.

Night Fever racing tracks

A game-changing addition to micro drone racing comes in the form of night time gym racing tracks, featuring neon gates and dynamic visual effects. This electrifying atmosphere creates an unforgettable racing experience, pushing your skills to the limit.

Parking Garage map

The Parking Garage map is a pure freestyle playground, offering a dense, multi-level urban environment perfect for technical flying. With tight gaps, ramps, and concrete structures, it’s the ultimate spot to hone your micro drone control and flow.
